timeline.text: Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity

notes.text:
HISTORY AND PHYSICAL. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. 70-year-old female admitted for community-acquired pneumonia. Admission data:
Day 0: labs bilirubin 0.44, creatinine 1.03, hemoglobin 12.6, pao2 55, platelets 309, sodium 139, wbc 5.7; vitals dbp 73-79, heart_rate 69-74, map 92-97, o2_flow 0-5, resp_rate 26-30, sbp 128-134, spo2 87-94, temp 36.8-36.9
Day 0 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV; Chest x-ray: right lower lobe opacity; Oxygen via nasal cannula 5 L/min
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia.

PROGRESS NOTE, hospital day 1. Patient interviewed and examined; nursing notes reviewed. Data:
Day 1: labs creatinine 1, hemoglobin 12.8, platelets 304, sodium 139, wbc 5.6; vitals dbp 75-79, heart_rate 70-74, map 93-98, o2_flow 5, resp_rate 22-25, sbp 128-135, spo2 93-95, temp 36.8-37
Day 1 orders/meds/results: Ceftriaxone 1 g IV
Assessment and plan: Community-acquired pneumonia. Continue current management.

DISCHARGE SUMMARY. 70-year-old female, length of stay 3 days. Hospital course: treated per the plan above with daily labs and vital signs; stable for discharge. Medications reconciled and return precautions reviewed. Discharge diagnoses: Community-acquired pneumonia. Follow up with primary care in one week. Patient seen and examined at bedside.
